planted_anomalies.detail: Batch BATCH-2026-B64675 is legitimately produced by MFG-IN-00015 but a second PRODUCED relationship from MFG-IN-00013 has been planted (via an extra Neo4j edge created from the anomaly-seed transaction). Detect with the 'multi-manufacturer batch' Cypher query.

Batch BATCH-2025-A7B41D shipped into WHS-IN-00009 from two different senders (DIST-IN-00002 and DIST-IN-00003) only 3 hours apart (shipments SHIP-CEAE76 and SHIP-25C36C). Detect with the duplicate-batch fan-in Cypher query (Listing 4.8 in the proposal).
Distributor DIST-IN-00001 ships batch BATCH-2026-F14542 to 18 distinct wholesalers in rapid succession, far above the network average out-degree. Detect with the abnormal fan-out heuristic.
Pharmacy PHARM-IN-00004 receives batch BATCH-2025-0B0618 twice, once from WHS-IN-00028 and once from WHS-IN-00033, a day apart. Detect with the re-entrant / repeat-receipt Cypher query.
